findings.uncertainty: No concrete harmful instruction was seen in lines 1400-1451. Lines 1-1399 were not fully read; the scan flagged only one other signal there, at line 274.

findings.claim: The scan flagged an SSH public-key file reference in a VM creation example. This is a normal Azure option, but I did not read the surrounding lines.
findings.why: It references a file in the user's SSH folder, though it is the public key, which is meant to be shared.
findings.uncertainty: Not inspected in context. It appears to be the standard az vm create usage.
